title: Marathon-Run to Plant
content: ATME College of Engineering in connection to college annual fest ATMEya- 2022-Regreening the Planet, had organised Marathon-Run to Plant on 12th June 2022 at 07.00 am in KD Circle. The event was flagged off by Sri . Prathap Simha, Member of Parliament Mysore-Kodagu constituency. Sri. L. Nagendra , Member of Legislative Assembly Chamaraja constituency was Guest of Honor. Mrs.Sunitha T, Range forest officer, Social Forestry division Mysore, Sri. Narayan, Sub Inspector of police Vijayanagar police station and Sri. M U Subanna, Advocate and corporator ward-20 vijaynagar Mysore city Corporation were the Special Invitees on the occasion.
